description: ANA - BHO250 - ÁREA DE DRENAGEM - ES is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Representação poligonal das áreas de contribuição hidrográfica, ottobacia, para cada trecho de drenagem, com seu código de bacia obtido a partir da metodologia de Otto Pfafstetter. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are ANA, AREA DE DRENAGEM, BHO250, ES, features. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
